name: Republic of Rose Island (1968–1969)
description: An orange field charged at the centre with a white shield bearing three red roses with green stems.
history: Flag of the Republic of Rose Island (Esperanto: Respubliko de la Insulo de la Rozoj), engineer Giorgio Rosa's 400 m² platform in the Adriatic off Rimini, which declared independence on 1 May 1968 with Esperanto as its official language. Italian authorities seized the platform weeks later and demolished it with explosives in February 1969.

features.role: white shield with three red roses
features.symbolism: the roses that gave the republic its name
